column7: claim
Likely drawn to private meditation, philosophy or spiritual inquiry.
Desires to separate nonattachment from social isolation.
Religion, philosophy and ultimate meaning are central to personal development.
Learns philosophical/spiritual principles through observation and listening.
Questioning success and letting go of attachments recur.
Spiritual growth and emotion may require responsible integration.
Should distinguish chosen solitude from avoidance/disconnection.
Should integrate knowledge, desire, wisdom, responsibility and action.
Virgo Karakamsa characterizes analytical discernment as a soul-development theme.
Jupiter Atmakaraka symbolizes lessons of wisdom and philosophical authority.
Moon Atmakaraka symbolizes lessons of emotional maturity and care.
Family and inherited values, speech, finances and principles matter to identity.
Need for a stable supportive domestic base is prominent.
Mother's symbolism is compassionate/aesthetic; father's guidance intellectual/educational.
Parents or siblings have particular traits corresponding to assigned karakas.
Work engages clients, alliances, partnerships and organizations.
Occupations using expertise and clear communication are particularly suitable.
Gradual attainments, positive reputation and professional achievement.
May improve social systems while maintaining emotional distance from status.
Cares about public recognition or gains OR detaches from both.
Practical accomplishment depends on responsibility and steady craft.
Knowledge must become communicable; creativity must become usable.
Potential leadership or professionally recognized expertise.
September 2026–February 2027 emphasizes organization, consolidation and responsibilities.
February 2027–February 2028 emphasizes reassessment, simplification and detachment.
February 2028–February 2031 emphasizes creative/romantic/vocational development.
February 2031–January 2032 emphasizes leadership, visibility, authority and family.
January 2032–July 2033 emphasizes relationships, family, emotional foundations and creativity.
July 2033–August 2034 emphasizes assertiveness, active technical execution and ambition.
Jupiter period from August 2034 emphasizes purpose, philosophy, guidance and responsibility.
Current Rahu/Saturn period until roughly July 2027 emphasizes constraints, duties and adjustment.
Current Rahu period emphasizes overcoming obstacles and technical improvements.
Future Rahu/Venus period emphasizes work, resources, security, home, social gains.
Jupiter period beginning roughly 2037 emphasizes knowledge, home, family values and communications.
Rahu period elevates novelty, expansion, desire, uncertainty and reassessment.
Planetary dignity/lordships should govern when dasha activates theme.
Jupiter weakness may be mitigated, allowing achievement rather than failure.
Neecha Bhanga does not guarantee extraordinary fortune; outcome noncommittal.
Strong romantic idealism may lead to forgiving people beyond reasonable limits.
Can be too focused on evidence while overlooking what is meaningful but hard to quantify.
May rely excessively on external intellectual authorities.
Might define success too narrowly by achievement or practical performance.
Comfort/status/gain pursuits may compete with emotional peace.
